messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: production /v1/generate p99 latency jumped to ~4.2s in us-west (~x15 baseline) and error-rate (502/504) rising. paging @eve-onncall. See telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/graphs/abc123 :rotating_light:

Eve-onncall: taking this — oncall pinged. gathering initial scope. Any deploys in last 30m?

Vikram: I pushed the small KV affinity change 18m ago (rev: afford-kv-shard-v14). rolling back if needed.

Maria: Confirmed increased 5xx spikes on ingress gateway + timeouts from runtime pool. Samples show `gateway:504` + `inference:timeout` from multiplexer.

Eve-onncall: ok. immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert afford-kv-shard-v14 on canary, 2) flip traffic fallback -> older model variant, 3) raise batching thresholds. I'll coordinate rollback now.

Vikram: taking revert. `git revert --no-edit 4a5b6c7 && infra/deploy --canary` — running.

Devon: pushing an immediate traffic rule to route to pool B (older kernel):

```
POST /api/v1/routing
{ "route": "/v1/generate", "policy": "prefer:pool-b" }
```
applied at 1768510032.

Maria: telemetry shows p95 back to 1.1s on canary region but prod still noisy. 502s dropping in pool-b but gateway timeouts from legacy frontends persist.

Eve-onncall: Vikram, status on revert?

Vikram: revert completed, canary deploy success. Will promote revert to prod if metrics keep improving in 2 min.

Slo-bot: SLO alert triggered: API error-rate breached 5m window threshold (target 0.5%). Current 5m error rate 2.9%.

Eve-onncall: Rolling revert to prod now. Notify on-call infra and customers later. Running gradual rollforward to minimize churn.

Devon: rollback promoted at 1768510110. Monitoring. Also bumped connection keepalive to 60s on gateways to reduce premature 504s.

Maria: After prod revert, p99 returned to ~700ms, p95 ~120ms. Error rate down to 0.7% and trending down. Some residual 502s from older cached instances — warming evictions in progress.

Eve-onncall: Good. Creating follow-up incident ticket and handoff to Vikram for postmortem. @vikram you own RCA + action items (KV sharding test, gradual rollout check, telemetry alert tuning).

Vikram: Ack. I'll capture timeline + repro. Initial theory: KV shard affinity change increases head-of-line latency under bursty multiplexer patterns causing request timeouts; the new kernel path exacerbated tail. We'll add canary throttling and unit test to simulate multiplex pressure.

Slo-bot: Customer impact estimate: ~3% of requests across us-west for ~25 minutes; customers with high-concurrency apps may have seen 502s/timeouts. See incident runbook link: https://runbook.redwood/timeout-regression

Eve-onncall: Handing off to Vikram for RCA. I'll remain available for follow-ups. Adding incident label: deploy-induced-latency. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Vikram: will post RCA by EOD. For immediate postmortem notes: improve canary checks (add p99 tail monitor), add rollback automation for small infra changes, add synthetic multiplex stress test to CI.

Eve-onncall: closing active pager. If anyone sees re-escalation, ping #incidents.

ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: p99 latency and 5xx returned to baseline after prod rollback. Incident duration: ~32m.
